caveat: No attack-labeled data was available in this handoff (only train_windows_n7.jsonl, benign windows). These are convergence and held-out-loss diagnostics, not detection accuracy. Real precision/recall/F1/AUC requires scoring a labeled benign+attack test set through this same model. Score direction note: this is negative log-likelihood loss (same convention as the LSTM track) — HIGHER = more surprising = more anomalous. Opposite direction from the HMM track's raw log-likelihood; see held_out_window_scores_hmm_format.csv for a sign-matched version.
